description: This file defines the 'Proxy' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. The class functions as a proxy pattern implementation that forwards method calls and property accesses to an underlying object stored in an internal data array, with support for magic methods like __get, __set, __call, __isset, and __unset.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A proxy class implementing dynamic method and property forwarding to an encapsulated object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves an object or property from the internal data array based on the given key, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets an object or property in the internal data array with the specified key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a given key exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the internal data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying object stored in the data array, with error handling for undefined methods.
